definitions.gloss: to start doing; to begin; to set about
definitions.explanation: To begin an action or activity, often with a sense of suddenly or energetically getting started. More casual and vivid than {始|はじ}める.

examples.japanese: ⟦{急|きゅう}→急：13042_kyuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧やり{出|だ}した。
{子|こ}どもたち⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{庭|にわ}→庭：02239_niwa⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦サッカー→サッカー：04726_sakkaa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧やり{出|だ}した。
examples.english: The children started playing soccer in the yard.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{一度|いちど}→一度：01312_ichido⟧やり{出|だ}す⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{止|と}まらない→止まる：00555_tomaru⟧⟦{性格|せいかく}→性格：03371_seikaku⟧だ。
examples.english: He has the kind of personality where once he starts something, he can't stop.

notes:
A compound verb combining ⟦やる→やる：02980_yaru⟧ (to do) + ⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧ (auxiliary verb indicating the start of an action). The ～⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧ pattern is productive in Japanese, attaching to many verbs to express the sudden or spontaneous beginning of an action.

More colloquial and energetic than {始|はじ}める. Often implies that the action began somewhat abruptly or without much deliberation.

COMMON PATTERNS:
The ～⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧ auxiliary can attach to many verb stems: ⟦{走|はし}り{出|だ}す→走り出す：06679_hashiridasu⟧ (start running), ⟦{泣|な}き{出|だ}す→泣き出す：06343_nakidasu⟧ (burst into tears), ⟦{笑|わら}い{出|だ}す→笑い出す：06678_waraidasu⟧ (start laughing). やり{出|だ}す is the most general form since ⟦やる→やる：02980_yaru⟧ covers doing anything.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{急|きゅう}→急：13042_kyuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧やり{出|だ}す: to suddenly start doing
- やり{出|だ}したら⟦{止|と}まらない→止まる：00555_tomaru⟧: once started, can't stop
- ⟦{勝手|かって}→勝手：03021_katte⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧やり{出|だ}す: to start doing on one's own

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {始|はじ}める: to begin — neutral and formal, works in all registers
- {取|と}りかかる: to set about; to get started on — emphasizes tackling a task
- し⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧: to start doing — similar compound but with ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ instead of ⟦やる→やる：02980_yaru⟧, slightly more formal
